property_summary: If a user u has a positive internal userBalance and calls withdrawBalance(), the contract forwards that exact amount to the callee (so a recording helper sees msg.value == the withdrawn amount); the mutant that sends 0 breaks this because the helper will record msg.value == 0 while the mapping was zeroed.
change_summary: Change the external call to send 0 value instead of tmp__1, altering whether funds are transferred while keeping balance zeroed locally.
